items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: That's Thomas Mitchell. He was a violin player too.

ctx.x: George Williams, you imagine that wouldn't be the drummer we know.

No, no. He's two not big enough. No, no, no. He was playing the drum. That's the one that switched the trombone. Now, that's my father-in-law again. Now, that's Amadei and that's one of the staffers. Now, this father, I don't know him. That's Thomas Mitchell. He was a violin player too.
